title: Merge Intervals
definition: Given an array of intervals, sort them by start time. Then iterate: if the current interval's start time is less than or equal to the previous interval's end time, merge them by updating the end time.
simpleExplanation: If you are busy from 1pm to 3pm, and your friend is busy from 2pm to 4pm, your combined busy schedule is simply 1pm to 4pm.
